ai_content.desc_en: Before the cult classic "Sex And Zen" by Michael Mak, there was Ho Fan's "Yu Pui Tsuen" (The Carnal Prayer Mat, 1987). The film tells the story of a young man who dreams of drowning after a night of carnal passion and seeks the translation of a Buddhist monk. The monk warns him not to indulge in the pleasures of the flesh to excess, but the man ignores his advice and marries a virgin, only to realize the wisdom of the monk's warning after several torrid affairs.
